description: Winner of BEST TOURING and BEST CARGO at BESPOKED LONDON 2026.Is it a bird? Is it a plane? Is it a mountain bike? Is it a cargo bike? The comments sections have been referring to it as a "CARGDURO" bike. We'll run with that for now. Combining all the functionality of a front loading cargo bike with modern suspension design and a badass presence, the GRIFFYN is the culmination of our lives work. It is quite literally the bike of our dreams, developed over the last year and now thoroughly tested in the wilds of Wales, it is ready to be owned by you.Photos Courtesy of John Watson

components.description: J-Unit COMP, Designed around a Manitou J-Unit fork with 120mm travel (internally adjustable down to 100mm)., Available in two versions: PRO or COMP.

Rear is 148x12mm BOOST with an I.S. Mount, Front is 110x15mm BOOST with a 160mm Post Mount, Conventional mech hanger is standard, but we can offer UDH dropouts instead upon request., NOTE: As this is a welded component, you can't change from a regular hanger to UDH without getting a new swingarm.
The rack is 500mm wide and 775mm long., Fits through doorways, Easily removable, Tiltable for storage (see the GIF above)

All frames come with our custom cargo pillow. This pad contains 10mm thick 3D foam for extra cushioning, and made from durable and waterproof 1000D Cordura., The tensioning system is simple 550 Paracord, which can be woven through the loops however you want, and which can also be easily re-tensioned if it becomes baggy over time.
Mara PRO Piggyback / Mara PRO XC Inline, 165mm of progressive linear travel driven by our take on the trusted DW linkage platform.

A Sentient Strap is included also. This is a 3m long strap made from Mil-Spec 50mm webbing and a truly unbeatable Austi-Alpin COBRA buckle. We keep them in stock with Silver and Black buckles, so you can pick which colour you prefer.
Front is a 44mm ID, for ZS44 upper and EC44 lower., Middle is 34mm ID, for EC34 conventional cups.
